headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.title: 研究报告预计：中国入境游未来10年或迎3万亿元市场增量
headlines.summary: 9月10日，中国商务部研究院国际服务贸易研究所在服贸会上发布《入境游促进消费的内在机理及增长潜力研究》，该报告在携程集团支持下完成，报告尤其关注中国入境游发展现状与特点。报告称，中国入境游已形成较好基础，有望迈入高质量发展新阶段，预计未来10年中国入境旅游收入占GDP比重有望提升至国际平均水平，这意味着约1万亿至3万亿元人民币的潜在市场增量。（环球时报）

headlines.title_en: Research report predicts: China's inbound tourism may see a 3 trillion yuan market increment in the next 10 years
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, the Institute of International Trade in Services of the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation under the Ministry of Commerce released a report titled "Research on the Internal Mechanisms and Growth Potential of Inbound Tourism in Promoting Consumption" at the CIFTIS. The report was completed with the support of Trip.com Group and focuses in particular on the current state and characteristics of China's inbound tourism development. The report states that China's inbound tourism has already formed a solid foundation and is expected to enter a new stage of high-quality development, and predicts that in the next 10 years the share of China's inbound tourism revenue in GDP is expected to rise to the international average, which implies a potential market increment of about 1 trillion to 3 trillion yuan. (Global Times)

headlines.title_en: Two-year US Treasury real yield rises about 12.5 basis points on the day of the release of US CPI inflation data, two-year US Treasury yield rises over 25.9 basis points for the week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (September 11) New York late trade: the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 0.43 basis points to 4.9669%, climbing to 4.9792% at 20:30 Beijing time when the US CPI inflation data was released, continuing to approach the October 23, 2023 peak of 5.0187%, then falling sharply to 4.9016% at 21:03 to refresh the daily low, showing a W-shaped trajectory throughout the day, and rose 18.48 basis points for the week. The two-year US Treasury yield rose 3.98 basis points to 4.6254%, reaching 4.6551% when the CPI inflation report was released, up 25.93 basis points for the week, accelerating upward on September 10.

headlines.title: 中方警告勿随意扩大苏丹制裁范围
headlines.summary: 中国常驻联合国代表团临时代办孙磊11日在安理会表决苏丹制裁问题决议草案后作解释性发言，警告不要随意扩大制裁范围。 孙磊说，考虑到安理会成员间分歧明显，执笔国美国提出对苏丹达尔富尔地区采取的制裁措施授权进行一个月的技术性延期，使大家有更充分时间讨论，中方对此不持异议，在表决中投了赞成票。中方一贯主张要确保决议草案的客观性、公正性和包容性，避免强推争议明显的案文。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: China warns against arbitrary expansion of Sudan sanctions scope
headlines.summary_en: Sun Lei, Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, made an explanatory statement on September 11 after the Security Council voted on the draft resolution on Sudan sanctions, warning against arbitrarily expanding the scope of sanctions. Sun Lei said that given the obvious differences among Security Council members, the penholder the United States proposed a one-month technical extension of the authorization for sanctions measures imposed on Sudan's Darfur region, giving everyone more time for discussion, and China had no objection to this and voted in favor. China has consistently advocated ensuring the objectivity, fairness and inclusiveness of draft resolutions and avoiding forcing through texts that are clearly controversial. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 新一轮以色列与黎巴嫩谈判推迟至10月举行
headlines.summary: 当地时间9月11日，一名美国高级官员称，原定于下周在罗马举行的新一轮以色列与黎巴嫩谈判已被推迟。作为替代，以色列和黎巴嫩驻美大使将在华盛顿美国国务院举行会晤，讨论近期事态发展以及两国框架协议的持续落实。该美国高级官员表示，下一轮正式谈判将于10月在罗马举行。一名知情人士称，由于犹太节日期间的日程安排、下周将在巴黎举行的加强黎巴嫩军队能力会议，以及联合国大会相关筹备工作，参与谈判的各方无法按原计划于下周在罗马举行会谈。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: A new round of Israel-Lebanon negotiations has been postponed to October
headlines.summary_en: On September 11 local time, a senior US official said that a new round of Israel-Lebanon negotiations originally scheduled to be held in Rome next week has been postponed. Instead, the Israeli and Lebanese ambassadors to the US will meet at the US State Department in Washington to discuss recent developments and the continued implementation of the framework agreement between the two countries. The senior US official said the next round of formal negotiations will be held in Rome in October. A person familiar with the matter said that due to scheduling during the Jewish holidays, a conference to strengthen the capabilities of the Lebanese army to be held in Paris next week, and preparations related to the UN General Assembly, the parties involved in the negotiations could not hold the talks in Rome next week as originally planned. (CCTV News)
